_meta.title: Backroom cruising A+B retained candidate research QA positions 81–85
_meta.confidence_rule: Directory discussion and official facility facts separated; online coordination not proof of physical cruising or current sexual access. Non-exhaustive cross-website alignment noted.

records.name: Hafenparkplatz Nürnberg Süd
records.identity: Original gay-szene OSM point 49.40698,11.07032 lies among Nürnberg port/canal access near Hafenstraße/Europakai/A73. A mapped harbour area is identifiable but exact safe public parking, changed by roadworks, isn't independently confirmed.

activity.detail: Reports reduced but possible interest, does not provide current sexual-activity evidence.

records.access: Industrial port and freight routes, previous work partly blocked parking; no current official safe car park or permitted waterside paths confirmed.
records.duplicate: Older 'Forstweiherwäldchen, Eibach' suggested alternative, NOT same spot or duplicate.
data_quality: Original coordinate is source map reference, not an exact operating parking entrance.
Contradictory January/February accounts mean no reliable current crowd peak.
Don't treat 2025 carpark partial reopening as permanent current access guarantee.

records.name: Klappe am Bismarckplatz
records.identity: Municipal public toilet on Stuttgart-West Bismarckplatz near bus stops and small park, source identifies square; stored 48.77383,9.15563 is place reference, not independently verified current WC cubicle.

activity.detail: Visitor reports midday encounter and that on other visits WC locked. One anonymous claim, not independent verification.

records.access: Ordinary municipal WC with inconsistent reported unlocking. No independently confirmed operator-specific toilet hours or privacy entitlement.
records.duplicates: Do not conflate Bismarckplatz Stuttgart-West with Schillerplatz Stuttgart-Vaihingen: separate toilets and city sectors.
data_quality: June2026 user report is site-specific, stronger than generic 2026 activity question, though uncorroborated.
No fixed time should be advertised from single midday encounter.
Do not use historical posts about park beside playground as access instructions.

records.name: Klappe am Schillerplatz
records.identity: Source Schillerplatz public underpass WC on Herrenberger Straße in Stuttgart-Vaihingen, not central Stuttgart Schillerplatz. Saved 48.73014,9.11296 is general square/underpass vicinity; precise door location not independent.

activity.detail: Poster says used back stall, saw another at urinal, no meeting.

records.access: Current access-hours and lock status uncertain; a June 2026 visit does show WC existed/was accessible at that moment, not a guarantee today.
records.duplicates: Do not mix central Schillerplatz and the district Vaihingen place.
data_quality: Existing description correctly acknowledges negative June2026 encounter evidence.
May say June18 one person reported using toilet, which is more concrete evidence of at least one open moment than only closure questions.
Do not assert opening time or recurring cruising.

records.name: Parkplatz Aschheim
records.identity: Planet Randy source identifies named roadside A99 parking between Aschheim and Kirchheim northeast of Munich. Saved 48.17992,11.72608 is broad map reference. Northbound direction in original research unverified against official motorway asset record in this pass; do not overstate entrance.
records.access: Motorway service parking subject to signed access and any work restrictions; no current authoritative access confirmation beyond mapped position.
records.duplicates: Separate from other A99 stop names; do not merge by same city alone.
data_quality: Current source signals are only the Nov30 2025 invitations.
Carriageway direction and parking entrance need operator-side verification before precise driving directions.
No supported crowd, peak, or recent encounter.

records.name: Aseos Mercat Sant Antoni
records.identity: Mercat Sant Antoni at Carrer del Comte d'Urgell 1, Barcelona Eixample, officially a current food, clothing and books market. Stored 41.379746,2.163218 general market point. Specific customer WC alleged by original post unknown.

activity.detail: No observed activity nor even confirmed current WC location.

records.access: Municipal official guide lists regular main market Monday–Saturday 08:00–20:30; separate Sunday book market distinct schedule. Barcelona Municipal Markets Institute tender 008_26000077 proposes adaptation of internal market spaces for public restrooms, evaluation status as of Nov 8 2026. This is procurement, NOT proof toilets already closed or built.
records.duplicates: No overlap with a different Barceloneta or Sant Antoni neighborhood WC merely by neighborhood title.
data_quality: Material: March/June–Sept 2026 tender remains in evaluation; don't state restroom remodelling has been completed or actual WC shut.
Main market retail hours cannot stand in for unverified toilet hours.
Avoid citing restroom as an authorized sexual venue based on a single query.

material_findings: Sant Antoni 2026 restroom redesign only in procurement evaluation stage, not finished/closed
Stuttgart Schillerplatz June18 2026 one WC visitor but no encounter; status not automatically closed
Stuttgart Bismarckplatz June5 2026 positive firsthand anonymous claim with intermittent locked door
